speaker: god
text: I have loved you,
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: How have You loved us?
name: The people

speaker: god
text: Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet Jacob I have loved,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: but Esau I have hated, and I have made his mountains a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals.
name: The LORD

speaker: edom
text: We have been devastated, but we will rebuild the ruins,
name: Edom

speaker: god
text: They may build, but I will demolish. They will be called the Land of Wickedness, and a people with whom the LORD is indignant forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will see this with your own eyes, and you yourselves will say, ‘The LORD is great—even beyond the borders of Israel.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A son honors his father, and a servant his master. But if I am a father, where is My honor? And if I am a master, where is your fear of Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you ask, ‘How have we despised Your name?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: By presenting defiled food on My altar. But you ask, ‘How have we defiled You?’ By saying that the table of the LORD is contemptible.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When you offer blind animals for sacrifice, is it not wrong? And when you present the lame and sick ones, is it not wrong? Try offering them to your governor! Would he be pleased with you or show you favor?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But ask now for God’s favor. Will He be gracious? Since this has come from your hands, will He show you favor?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Oh, that one of you would shut the temple doors, so that you would no longer kindle useless fires on My altar! I take no pleasure in you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and I will accept no offering from your hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place, incense and pure offerings will be presented in My name, because My name will be great among the nations,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you profane it when you say, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is contemptible.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You also say: ‘Oh, what a nuisance!’ And you turn up your nose at it,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You bring offerings that are stolen, lame, or sick! Should I accept these from your hands?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But cursed is the deceiver who has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it, but sacrifices a defective animal to the Lord. For I am a great King,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and My name is to be feared among the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And now this decree is for you, O priests:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will rebuke your descendants, and I will spread dung on your faces, the waste from your feasts, and you will be carried off with it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you will know that I have sent you this commandment so that My covenant with Levi may continue,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My covenant with him was one of life and peace, which I gave to him; it called for reverence, and he revered Me and stood in awe of My name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: True instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from iniquity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the lips of a priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you have departed from the way, and your instruction has caused many to stumble. You have violated the covenant of Levi,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I in turn have made you despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not kept My ways, but have shown partiality in matters of the law.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: Why?
name: The people

speaker: god
text: For I hate divorce,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence,
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: How have we wearied Him?
name: The people

speaker: israelites
text: All who do evil are good in the sight of the LORD, and in them He delights,
name: The people

speaker: israelites
text: Where is the God of justice?
name: The people

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple—the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight—see, He is coming,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I will draw near to you for judgment. And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet from the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you ask, ‘How can we return?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Will a man rob God? Yet you are robbing Me! But you ask, ‘How do we rob You?’ In tithes and offerings.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are cursed with a curse, yet you—the whole nation—are still robbing Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house. Test Me in this,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land, and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your words against Me have been harsh,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will be Mine,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Not a root or branch will be left to them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers. Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.
name: The LORD
